resources.string: A row of digits above the letters
Function keys on the other side
Enter, ⇧ and ?123 move to the opposite side, for the left thumb
One letter, an equals sign and the symbols per line. The first symbol is shown in the key\'s corner; the letter\'s accents follow.
The keys float over the app; drag the bar above them to move them
Type kana on a 12-key pad: tap for the あ column, flick left, up, right or down for the others
After the first characters of an idiom, offer the rest. Uses the Idioms dictionary you download under Dictionaries
Start with u, then h 一, s 丨, p 丿, n 丶, z 乙 for the strokes in order
Start with v: a number (v1234 → 一千二百三十四, capital money), vrq the date, vsj the time, vxq the weekday, vu and a hex code a Unicode character, or a sum (v1+2*3)
One abbreviation (letters and digits), an equals sign and the text per line; type v and the abbreviation.
